title.narrative: Livelihoods, Resilience and Heritage: Rehabilitation of traditional water management systems & other rural community infrastructure in Southern Afghanistan

description.narrative: Afghanistan and in particular, the southern region have faced years of disasters related to natural and human-induced hazards and have been neglected for a long time with no clear responsible entity. Due to the security situation over the past decades, there has been little opportunity for cultural activities, and many local communities are marginalised, with extreme poverty and widespread unemployment that need urgent humanitarian and development aid. The Government of Japan has been supporting the people of Afghanistan for more than two decades in various sectors, particularly in education, water management sector, emergency and humanitarian areas. As this project is both an emergency response to the recently flood-affected people and provides water and short-term employment as basic human needs, particularly, for returnees, IDPs, rural nomad communities and local vulnerable communities, it can be defined under the scope of this supplementary budget.
